description: Disabling two-factor auth takes no arguments: the confirm gate, the POST, and the dry-run preview, which carries the security warning the downgrade earns.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This disables two-factor authentication for the profile. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: Two-factor authentication is disabled for this profile.
warnings: Disabling two-factor authentication reduces account security.
